preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 10**5 for N in Ns)
preconditions.description: Length of each string N is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= K <= N for K in Ks)
preconditions.description: Number of partitions K is between 1 and N.
Each string S contains only lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of test cases T.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output_lines[i]) == len(Ss[i]) for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: The length of each output line matches the length of the corresponding input string S.
Each output line is the lexicographically smallest string that can be created from the corresponding input string S.
